summaryStatement: Nineteen listed attacks were each pressed against live bytes and each failed. The distinguishing claim of v4 - that occupancy v2 (D-227) supersedes occupancy v1 as the current occupancy of the already-named DR-G27 identifier - was verified at the D-227 adoption commit and in COORD, not accepted from the subject. A field-by-field diff against v3 shows the artifact moves exactly one obligation reason and adds exactly one field, both of which are the remasurement, with no other change riding along. The leftover-design set is unchanged at [OBL-G27-FX-AUTHORING], required-now stays 28 as measured at the live condition-4 cell, all 35 cited digests reproduce byte-exactly with no cross-citation conflict, and the subject is unmoved at 0444. No MUST-FIX and no SHOULD-FIX stand.
